scope: Offline re-audit and full re-export of all saved real Kimi Round2-5 Episodes; no API call, collection, or SFT training

artifact.per_case_audit: audit.correctness-v1.json beside each of 109 source Episodes, also summarized in audit-report.json.cases

source_coverage.round2_block_reason: Three lack a frozen witness manifest; one recorded manifest fails SHA/content identity. None is silently retained.

before_after.interpretation: The net gain is 11 qualified action rows. Three old Round2 uncertain terminals are removed because current frozen-witness identity cannot verify them. Existing Round2-5 records contain no multi-defect Episode, so the first_failure semantic fix recovers zero historical rows by itself; its reviewer regression is covered by unit tests.

image_identity.naming: Episode ID plus call/index plus full source-content SHA-256
image_identity.existing_destination_policy: Reuse only on exact SHA-256 equality; otherwise atomically rebuild and verify

handoff: Safe as a hash-verified train-only augmentation for separate action and diagnosis objectives. It is not a standalone train/validation dataset: only four independent source assets, no pass labels, and no validation rows.
